newsitem.title: UK: FTSE sees small loss, becalmed in end-of-week lull.
newsitem.headline: FTSE sees small loss, becalmed in end-of-week lull.

text.p: The FTSE 100 dawdled at slightly lower levels on Friday in thin, end-of-week trading, shrugging off strong growth figures and waiting for Wall Street to provide direction, dealers said.
The index was at a session low by 0957 GMT, 11.3 points off at 4,377.2. "Everything's just looking a little tired and Friday-like," said one dealer.

The Dow's overnight loss took the market lower in opening trade and continuing uncertainty over the outcome of next Thursday's general election and the likelihood of rate rises soon kept prices and activity subdued.
